quest.nirncraft.board.empty: No notices are posted right now.
quest.nirncraft.board.innkeeper_intro: The steward and townsfolk keep the notice board in %s stocked with work. Take whichever posting suits your blade:
quest.nirncraft.board.accepted_reply: Consider it yours. I've marked %s on your map — return when the job is done for your %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.board.invalid_index: Pick a notice index between 0 and %s.
quest.nirncraft.board.already_taken: You have already taken or completed that notice.
quest.nirncraft.board.none_nearby: No settlement notice board is nearby.
quest.nirncraft.board.turnin_reply: Fine work! The whole town will sleep easier tonight. Here is the %s gold promised on the notice board.
quest.nirncraft.board.bandit_bounty.desc: By order of %3$s: the outlaw leader %1$s has made a camp at %2$s and preys upon travellers along the roads. Slay %1$s to claim the %4$s Septim bounty.
quest.nirncraft.board.beast_hunt.title: Hunt: %s near %s
quest.nirncraft.board.beast_hunt.desc: Hunters from %3$s report that %1$s has been stalking livestock and travellers near %2$s (%4$sm away). Track down and slay the beast, then bring word back to %3$s.
quest.nirncraft.board.lost_heirloom.desc: %1$s of %4$s offers a reward for the recovery of a family %2$s lost inside %3$s. Retrieve the heirloom and return it to %4$s.
quest.nirncraft.board.missing_person.des: %1$s set out from %3$s toward %2$s (%4$sm away) and has not returned. Search %2$s for any sign of %1$s and bring word back to %3$s.
quest.nirncraft.board.supply_order.title: Supply Order: %sx %s
quest.nirncraft.board.supply_order.desc: Merchant %1$s in %5$s has posted a contract for %2$sx %3$s gathered from the stores around %4$s.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.notice_board: Any work on the notice board?
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.board_turnin: I slew %s from the notice board.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.board_heirloom: I recovered the %s from the notice board.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.board_missing: I searched for %s from the notice board.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.board_supply: I brought the %sx %s for the notice board order.
quest.nirncraft.story.jerall_mountains.r: Have you heard? Sledges coming down from Pale Pass are being taxed twice—once by Countess Carvain's gate-reeves and again by the Legion detachment—while sealed crates slip through the snows unchecked.
quest.nirncraft.story.jerall_mountains.n: BY ORDER OF CASTLE BRUMA & THE NORTHERN LEGION: Caravanners holding duplicate Pale Pass tariff receipts are to present their tallies at the Bruma gatehouse immediately.
quest.nirncraft.story_jerall_mountains_0: Inspect the contested Pale Pass toll-ledgers at Bruma's northern gatehouse
Question the stranded Nord timber-drovers at Bleaker's Way about the midnight collectors
Return the counterfeit wax impressions to Captain Burd and the Legion quartermaster in Bruma
Examine the sledge-tracks leading off the Bruma highway toward Fort Dragonclaw
Clear the false-livery toll collectors out of Fort Dragonclaw and seize their iron signet-press
Deliver the recovered waybills to the caravanners waiting at Bleaker's Way
Carry the ciphered Ash-Syndicate tablet from Bleaker's Way up the mountain trail
Consult the old Blades chronicler at Cloud Ruler Temple to decode the Reman-era pass map
Scout the snow-choked customs vaults at Fort Pale Pass where the contraband is cached
Storm the inner customs vault at Fort Pale Pass and defeat Factor Corvus Bellor's guard
Seize the Council of Ash bullion chest and the true Imperial toll-charter
Witness Countess Carvain and the Legion legate sign the Pale Pass Tariff Concord in Bruma
quest.nirncraft.story.colovian_highlands: Every wool-factor between Chorrol and Battlehorn has dropped the Fighters Guild for a cheap broker wearing an ash-grey seal—and any shepherd who refuses wakes up to goblins in his fold.
CHORROL FIGHTERS GUILD HALL: Sellswords and investigators wanted beneath the Great Oak to look into the staged goblin raids on the Colovian wool-runs.
quest.nirncraft.story_colovian_highlands: Review the cancelled shepherd-escort contracts at the Chorrol Fighters Guild hall
Inspect the burned wool-wagons outside Battlehorn Castle and question the drovers
Bring the painted goblin-totem splinter back to the Guild steward in Chorrol
Follow the sawdust trail south from Chorrol toward the ridge above Fort Carmala
Drive off the hired totem-planters at Fort Carmala and seize their route-map
Trace the wagon-ruts to the timber depot near Hackdirt
Question the teamsters outside Hackdirt about the night shipments to Fort Ash
Infiltrate the outer court of Fort Ash and recover the double-entry wool and mercenary ledger
Present the ledger to Countess Valga's herald and the Fighters Guild steward in Chorrol
Storm the keep of Fort Ash and defeat Provost Mallius Varro's mercenary company
Recover the stolen Colovian Wool-Staple Charter and Council of Ash correspondence
Convene the Great Oak Assize in Chorrol to restore the Fighters Guild's highland contracts
quest.nirncraft.story.heartlands.title: The Ring Beneath the Rings
quest.nirncraft.story.heartlands.rumour: Two Elder Council clerks were pulled from Lake Rumare at dawn, each clutching a freshly illuminated pedigree naming a different nobleman as heir to the Ruby Throne.
quest.nirncraft.story.heartlands.notice: IMPERIAL WATCH PROCLAMATION: Information regarding the counterfeit Chancery seals circulating in the Market District and around Lake Rumare will be richly rewarded.
quest.nirncraft.story_heartlands_01_two_: Examine the two matching Septim pedigree rolls at the Imperial Watch post in the Imperial City
Track the parchment-maker's watermark north across the lake road to Aleswell
Bring the vellum sample and ink-receipt back to the Chancery archivist in the Imperial City
quest.nirncraft.story_heartlands_02_ink_: Follow the gold-beater's delivery list from the Imperial City across the northern causeway
Clear the hired cutthroats out of Fort Caractacus and recover the engraved brass signet-dies
Question the courier's factor waiting at Roxey Inn
quest.nirncraft.story_heartlands_03_the_: Ride south from Roxey Inn along the Red Ring Road toward Pell's Gate
Meet the retired sewer-warden in Pell's Gate to learn which sluice-gate leads under the Palace
Seize the Ayleid ring-key from the Council of Ash garrison at Fort Alessia
quest.nirncraft.story_heartlands_04_the_: Carry the Ayleid ring-key from Fort Alessia back to the Imperial City underworks
Descend into the Ring Beneath the Rings and defeat Chief Herald Caelia Vane's bodyguards
Shatter the forgery press and lay the Council of Ash's subscriber roll before the Elder Council
quest.nirncraft.story.great_forest.title: The Forest Lectures
quest.nirncraft.story.great_forest.rumou: Three Arcane University survey-scholars walked into the Great Forest west of Weye with a crate of empty welkynd cages, and only their pack-mule came back.
quest.nirncraft.story.great_forest.notic: ARCANE UNIVERSITY & WEYNON PRIORY: Reward offered at Weye and Wawnet Inn for word of the missing Ayleid survey party in the Great Forest.
quest.nirncraft.story_great_forest_01_mi: Speak with the bridge-wardens in Weye about the Arcane University survey team's route
Search the scholars' rented room at Wawnet Inn for their field-map
Recover the bloodied brass astrolabe outside Fort Nikel
quest.nirncraft.story_great_forest_02_th: Follow the lantern-ash markers south from Fort Nikel through the oak-glades
Clear the Black Wormgrave-robbers from Fort Virtue and seize their scrip-pouch
Bring the Elder Council scrip tokens back to the University envoy in Weye
quest.nirncraft.story_great_forest_03_vl: Set out from Weye along the southern forest track toward Vlastarus
Free the surviving apprentice held at the Vlastarus waystation
Reconnoitre the necromantic lecture-ring inside Fort Vlastarus
quest.nirncraft.story_great_forest_04_th: Disrupt the midnight convocation at Fort Vlastarus and destroy Provost-Lich Malakor
Shatter the welkynd soul-conduit and recover the abducted scholars' journals
Return the journals and the Council of Ash requisition seal to the University envoy in Weye
quest.nirncraft.story.nibenay_basin.rumo: Someone scuttled a silk-barge right across Cheydinhal's Corbolo canal lock, and now the Dunmer banking-house and the old Nibenese silk-gentry are hiring blades against each other.
quest.nirncraft.story.nibenay_basin.noti: CHEYDINHAL CANAL CHANCERY: Neutral investigators sought to examine the scuttled silk-barge in the Corbolo Lock before the Charter Assize convenes.
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_basin_01_t: Inspect the augered hull timbers of the sunken barge in Cheydinhal's Corbolo canal
Question the young noblemen at the Knights of the Thorn Lodge who witnessed the night watch
Report the foreign auger-marks to both banking factors in Cheydinhal
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_basin_02_s: Trace the discounted promissory notes from Cheydinhal's counting-houses south toward Harlun's Watch
Recover the burned silk-warehouse tally from the factor's clerk at Harlun's Watch
Verify the Valus caravan bullion receipts with the smiths at Shurgak Clan Estate
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_basin_03_t: Follow the debt-collectors south from Shurgak Clan Estate along the basin road
Intercept the Council of Ash courier at Cropsford and seize the sealed Charter instructions
Carry the intercepted instructions back to Castle Cheydinhal
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_basin_04_c: Escort the Cropsford silk-witnesses north to the Charter Assize in Cheydinhal
Defeat Arbiter Flavius Olo's hired enforcers at the Corbolo canal warehouse
Witness Count Andel Indarys seal the Joint Corbolo Canal Charter between Dunmer and Nibenese houses
quest.nirncraft.story.west_weald.title: Two Vintages, One Cask
quest.nirncraft.story.west_weald.rumour: Both the Surilie and Tamika vintage wains were ambushed outside Skingrad on the same night, and somebody left each rival's wax seal pinned to the smashed casks.
quest.nirncraft.story.west_weald.notice: SKINGRAD VINTNERS' GUILD & CASTLE STEWARD: Experienced investigator wanted to examine the sabotaged wine-presses and missing reserve casks.
quest.nirncraft.story_west_weald_01_sour: Inspect the smashed wine-casks and counterfeit wax stamps outside Skingrad's western gate
Question the cellar-carters drinking at The Blue Netch about the night wagons
Return the unstaved oak hoop to Castle Skingrad's steward
quest.nirncraft.story_west_weald_02_the_: Follow the cooper's iron-mark west from Skingrad along the Gold Road
Inspect the cellar receipts at the Roadside Gilded Carafe
Clear the cellar-raiders out of Fort Linchal and recover the stolen reserve casks
quest.nirncraft.story_west_weald_03_cell: Track the blackmail couriers west from Fort Linchal toward Fort Hastrel
Search the limestone name-vault beneath Fort Hastrel for the master cipher-book
Deliver the cipher-book to Count Hassildor's nocturnal chamberlain in Skingrad
quest.nirncraft.story_west_weald_04_the_: Purge Varo Caelius's remaining syndicate cell at Fort Hastrel
Burn the Council of Ash blackmail rolls in Castle Skingrad's courtyard
Witness the Surilie and Tamika houses tap the reconciliation cask in Skingrad
quest.nirncraft.story.gold_coast.title: What the Ash Remembers
quest.nirncraft.story.gold_coast.rumour: Relief ships bound for Kvatch keep running aground on dark nights north of Anvil, and the dressed stone meant for Kvatch's walls is turning up in private coastal villas.
quest.nirncraft.story.gold_coast.notice: ANVIL HARBOUR & KVATCH REBUILDING FUND: Urgent commission to trace the missing masonry convoys and investigate the false beacon lights along the Gold Coast.
quest.nirncraft.story_gold_coast_01_miss: Audit the Kvatch relief manifests at Anvil's harbourmaster office
Question the teamsters at Brina Cross Inn about the diverted stone-wains
Deliver the surviving mortar-wagons to the masons' camp at Kvatch
quest.nirncraft.story_gold_coast_02_the_: Trace the stolen crane-chains down from Kvatch toward Marja's Mill
Inspect the smuggler oil-casks hidden behind Marja's Mill
Clear the wrecker lookouts near Gottshaw Inn and smash their false signal-lantern
quest.nirncraft.story_gold_coast_03_cind: Follow the wrecker paymaster's trail south toward The Withered Rose
Seize the speculator's ledger of Oblivion-glass shipments at The Withered Rose
Locate the hidden excavation shaft beneath the Great Gate scar at Kvatch
quest.nirncraft.story_gold_coast_04_the_: Descend into the ash-cavern beneath Kvatch and defeat Speculator-Prefect Titus Vane
Seal the Oblivion fissure and return the stolen reconstruction chest to Kvatch's masons
Proclaim the Gold Coast Reconstruction Charter at Castle Anvil
quest.nirncraft.story.nibenay_valley.rum: Every copper coin tossed into the Lucky Old Lady's fountain in Bravil vanishes before dawn, replaced by stamped brass tokens that only the midnight skooma-barges accept.
quest.nirncraft.story.nibenay_valley.not: CHAPEL OF MARA & BRAVIL CANAL WATCH: Seeking an honest blade to investigate the night-tampering at the Lucky Old Lady plaza and Lunar Fang Docks.
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_valley_01_: Keep watch over the Lucky Old Lady statue in Bravil and collect the stamped brass tokens
Follow the token-runner along the canal boardwalk to Lunar Fang Docks
Show the harbour-stamp impression to Sister-Almoner Viera at the Bravil Chapel
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_valley_02_: Track the night-barge couriers north from Bravil along the Green Road
Search the courier's saddlebags at the Inn of Ill Omen for the river-lock schedule
Question the retired lock-keeper at Faregyl Inn about Clerk Petronius's hidden cistern
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_valley_03_: Cross the Niben valley east from Faregyl Inn toward Fort Aurus
Defeat the river-syndicate guards at Fort Aurus and recover the bronze cistern key
Carry the bronze key back to the Lucky Old Lady plaza in Bravil
quest.nirncraft.story_nibenay_valley_04_: Bring the Fort Aurus tariff rolls downriver to Bravil
Unlock the plaza cistern beneath the Lucky Old Lady and defeat Clerk Petronius's syndicate guard
Distribute the recovered customs chest to the Chapel of Mara's canal-alms house in Bravil
quest.nirncraft.story.blackwood.title: The Sap Ledger
quest.nirncraft.story.blackwood.rumour: Cracked glass ampoules of warm amber sap washed up in Leyawiin's reed-canals at dawn, and An-Xileel scouts have been sighted along the eastern mangrove causeway.
quest.nirncraft.story.blackwood.notice: LEYAWIIN HARBOUR WATCH & CHAPEL OF ZENITHAR: Envoy sought to trace the illicit Hist-sap ampoules before border hostilities erupt along the Niben mouth.
quest.nirncraft.story_blackwood_01_amber: Examine the washed-up amber ampoules at Leyawiin's Tide-Gate dock
Question the Argonian reed-weavers at Blankenmarch about the midnight flatboats
Return the stamped copper crate-seal to the Leyawiin harbour watch
quest.nirncraft.story_blackwood_02_the_t: Travel upriver from Leyawiin with the Saxhleel speaker toward Water's Edge
Inspect the copper tapping-spiles driven into the sunken Hist root-runner near Water's Edge
Consult the Khajiit scouts at Border Watch who tracked the sap-mules north
quest.nirncraft.story_blackwood_03_drunk: Cross the marsh road east from Border Watch to The Drunken Dragon Inn
Defeat the sap-broker's bodyguards at The Drunken Dragon Inn and seize the Sap Ledger
Meet the An-Xileel border-envoy at Blankenmarch to show proof of the northern buyers
quest.nirncraft.story_blackwood_04_truce: Destroy the hidden copper sap-stills in the mangroves outside Blankenmarch
Deliver the living Hist root-cutting to the Saxhleel elders in Leyawiin
Witness Count Caro and the marsh envoys seal the Niben Mouth Border Truce
quest.nirncraft.story.stonefalls.title: The Charter of Ash and Salt
quest.nirncraft.story.stonefalls.rumour: At Ebonheart's East Empire quays, two sets of customs manifests bear the Grand Council's stamp while cargo vanishes between Davon's Watch and Kragenmoor.
quest.nirncraft.story.stonefalls.notice: BY WARRANT OF THE GRAND COUNCIL AT EBONHEART — Investigators sought to audit the duplicate Inner Sea customs seals between Ebonheart, Davon's Watch, and Kragenmoor.
quest.nirncraft.story_stonefalls_01_doub: Two Seals on the Inner Sea
Compare the duplicate customs registers at the East Empire Company Hall and Grand Council Chambers in Ebonheart
Inspect the unlogged night-lighters moored below the sea-wall at Davon's Watch
Question the Hlaalu toll-factors in Kragenmoor about the Ash-Mountain wax matrix
quest.nirncraft.story_stonefalls_02_smok: Track the smuggler mule-train north from Kragenmoor toward the lava-ridge at Fort Arand
Clear the renegade tariff-wardens holding Fort Arand and recover the Brass Stamp-Die
Carry the Brass Stamp-Die to the Redoran border-magistrates at Silgrad Tower
quest.nirncraft.story_stonefalls_03_arma: Consult the Redoran archivists in Blacklight on the old Pact-era keys to Ash Mountain
Retrieve the Dwemer pressure-key from the reliquary vaults beneath Heimlyn Keep
Defeat the smuggling cabal inside the Ash Mountain steam-armature and seal the contraband sluice
quest.nirncraft.story_stonefalls_04_conc: Intercept the corrupt legate's mercenary rearguard beneath the stone colossi at Brothers of Strife
Present the Ash Mountain ledger to the Grand Council Chambers in Ebonheart
Witness the Imperial and Great House delegates ratify the renewed Inner Sea Customs Concord
quest.nirncraft.story.deshaan.title: The Unseen Hand in Godsreach
quest.nirncraft.story.deshaan.rumour: In Mournhold's Great Bazaar, Indoril ordinators and Dres factors whisper that forged Temple quarantine writs are being used to seize caravan warehouses while Almalexia remains unseen.
quest.nirncraft.story.deshaan.notice: PROCLAMATION OF GODSREACH & THE ROYAL PALACE — Capable investigators sought to verify the Quarantine Serk seals and inspect the Dwemer shafts beneath Bamz-Amschend.
quest.nirncraft.story_deshaan_01_writs_o: Examine the disputed Temple quarantine seals in Mournhold's Great Bazaar and Godsreach
Travel to Quarantine Serk and question the apothecaries about the falsified plague tallies
Verify the Hlaalu caravan bills with the council factors at Narsis
quest.nirncraft.story_deshaan_02_chains_: Question the Dres dock-stewards in Tear regarding the impounded grain barges
Locate the runaway shelter in Silent Mire where the honest Temple clerk took refuge
Have the mages at Shad Astula decipher the ciphered signet-ledger brought from Silent Mire
quest.nirncraft.story_deshaan_03_bells_o: Storm the outer watch-court of Taldeic Fortress and recover the stolen Indoril Signet-Ring
Descend into Bamz-Amschend beneath Mournhold and defeat the schismatic Ordinator prelate
Carry the recovered Indoril Signet-Ring back to Godsreach in Mournhold
quest.nirncraft.story_deshaan_04_judgmen: Silence the last hired Dres mercenaries gathered at Eidolon's Hollow
Deliver the full evidence before the Royal Palace and Temple High Fane in Mournhold
Receive the joint commendation of Godsreach and the Royal Court of Mournhold
quest.nirncraft.story.molag_amur.title: The Ossuary Ledger of Necrom
quest.nirncraft.story.molag_amur.rumour: Corpse-ships arriving at Zaappi Docks and Necrom's white walls have been turned away after someone stole the ancestral burial charters from the lower ossuaries.
quest.nirncraft.story.molag_amur.notice: EDICT OF THE KEEPERS OF THE DEAD AT NECROM — Seekers required to recover the stolen Ossuary Roll from the ash-wastes between Alavelis, Camonnaruhn, and Bthar-Zel.
quest.nirncraft.story_molag_amur_01_seal: Speak with the Keepers of the Dead in Necrom regarding the missing Ossuary Roll
Inspect the waiting funeral barges moored at Zaappi Docks
Follow the ash-wheel tracks inland to the caravan post at Alavelis
quest.nirncraft.story_molag_amur_02_raid: Set out from Alavelis across the basalt ridge toward Camonnaruhn
Clear the outcast raiders occupying Camonnaruhn and recover the bronze reliquary case
Trace the buyers of the missing parchment leaves to the hillside vaults of Bal Sunnar
quest.nirncraft.story_molag_amur_03_stea: Cross the eastern cinder-wash from Bal Sunnar to the Dwemer citadel of Bthar-Zel
Defeat the bone-binders inside Bthar-Zel and reclaim the intact Ossuary Roll of Necrom
Purge the Daedric shrine-altar at Uhaammu where the stolen ancestor-seals were being profaned
quest.nirncraft.story_molag_amur_04_whit: Signal the waiting funeral barges at Zaappi Docks that the ossuary gates are reopening
Restore the Ossuary Roll to the Keepers of the Dead in the high catacombs of Necrom
Receive the Ash-Lantern Blessing before the white walls of Necrom
quest.nirncraft.story.telvannis.title: The Third Root of Tel Naga
quest.nirncraft.story.telvannis.rumour: At the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora, Mouths and Imperial clerks alike complain that rogue spore-anchor experiments are warping the fungal sea-lanes between Wolverine Hall, Firewatch, and Port Telvannis.
quest.nirncraft.story.telvannis.notice: NOTICE OF THE COUNCIL AT TEL NAGA — Competent outlanders or retainers hired to investigate the unstable root-conduits between Sadrith Mora, Firewatch, and Port Telvannis.
quest.nirncraft.story_telvannis_01_spore: Take the commission from the Council Mouths at Tel Naga and the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora
Compare the Mages Guild aetheric readings inside Wolverine Hall
Inspect the scorched fungal root-graft at Tel Rendys
quest.nirncraft.story_telvannis_02_beaco: Question the Imperial charter-inspectors in Firewatch about the stolen Dwemer coils
Check the magisterial factor-ledgers on the mushroom docks of Port Telvannis
Seize the smuggling manifest from the storage vaults at Voryn Plantation
quest.nirncraft.story_telvannis_03_tower: Secure a boat-passage and ward-salts from the Indoril factors at Gorne
Clear the mutated spore-thralls inside Tel Dreloth and dismantle the Dwemer root-core
Purge the secondary spore-vent inside Ikhuraarnit Egg Mine
quest.nirncraft.story_telvannis_04_prece: Present the dismantled Dwemer root-core to the Council Mouths inside Tel Naga
Deliver the stabilized aetheric readings to the Imperial liaison at Sadrith Mora
Claim your Magisterial Precedent Writ at the Gateway Plaza in Sadrith Mora
quest.nirncraft.story.sheogorad.title: False Beacons on the Sea of Ghosts
quest.nirncraft.story.sheogorad.rumour: Fishermen at Dagon Fel's End of the World tavern swear someone is lighting false storm-lanterns on the basalt skerries to lure cogs onto the rocks while blaming the Urshilaku hunters.
quest.nirncraft.story.sheogorad.notice: DAGON FEL HARBOUR WATCH — Reward posted for uncovering who tends the false wrecking-fires between Dagon Fel, Sanctus Shrine, and Vas.
quest.nirncraft.story_sheogorad_01_lante: Inspect the salvaged rudder and whale-oil casks on the quay at Dagon Fel
Speak with the vowed hermit at Sanctus Shrine regarding the night-signals on the western rocks
Compare the Ashlander coast-patrol reports at Urshilaku Camp
quest.nirncraft.story_sheogorad_02_signa: Search the cliff-top gallery at Sulipund for the brass signal-mirror
Defeat the wrecker lookouts camped in the stronghold ruins of Valenvaryon
Inspect the hidden boat-landing beneath the tower of Ald Redaynia
quest.nirncraft.story_sheogorad_03_coven: Storm the Daedric island tower of Vas and break the wrecker captain's coven
Smash the false beacon-brazier atop the shrine of Addadshashanammu
Recover the stolen Dagon Fel harbour-bell from the cavern cache at Shushishi
quest.nirncraft.story_sheogorad_04_bell_: True Light on the Northern Watchtower
Have the recovered harbour-bell blessed in silence at Sanctus Shrine
Rehang the harbour-bell and light the true sea-beacon at Dagon Fel
Share the peace-feast between the Nord whalers and Dunmer scouts at Dagon Fel
quest.nirncraft.story.vvardenfell_ashlan: Beneath the giant emperor-crab shell of Skar in Ald'ruhn, Redoran guards whisper that ash-caravans from Gnisis and Maar Gan have found red-wax Sixth House bells hidden inside supply crates.
REDORAN COUNCIL PROCLAMATION AT ALD'RUHN — Outlanders and retainers summoned to investigate the Sleeper caches along the ash-road between Ald'ruhn, Maar Gan, and Kogoruhn.
quest.nirncraft.story_vvardenfell_ashlan: Receive your briefing from Councilor Sarethi's clerks beneath Skar in Ald'ruhn
Inspect the quarantined guar-sheds and shrine stones at Maar Gan
Question the Legion and Redoran patrol captains at Gnisis about the northern ash-tracks
Muster with the Redoran outriders on the ridge at Bal Isra
Clear the Sleeper cell inside Falasmaryon and shatter their red-wax chime rack
Check the ancient propylon chamber at Andasreth for the cult's retreat route
Receive the pilgrim's ash-blessing at the Maar Gan shrine before crossing into the blight-wind
Enter the Sixth House citadel of Kogoruhn and slay the Ash-Priest of the Northern Choir
Deliver the captured Sixth House battle-plan to the garrison at Buckmoth Legion Fort
Lay the shattered Ash-Priest bell before the Redoran Council Hall inside Skar
Witness the Ashlander caravan-truce renewed at the western gate of Ald'ruhn
Receive the Helm-Salute of the Redoran Council in Ald'ruhn
quest.nirncraft.story.grazelands.title: The Blighted Pastures of Vos
quest.nirncraft.story.grazelands.rumour: In the farming village of Vos beneath Tel Vos's twisted roots, wickwheat growers and Zainab scouts accuse each other of poisoning the grazing springs while kwama mines go rabid.
quest.nirncraft.story.grazelands.notice: DECREE OF MASTER ARYON AT TEL VOS — Investigators sought to examine the fouled watering-runs between Vos, Zainab Camp, and Mudan-Mul Egg Mine.
quest.nirncraft.story_grazelands_01_bitt: Speak with the village elders at Vos about the blighted irrigation channels
Consult Master Aryon's steward in the Imperial-fungal hybrid tower of Tel Vos
Parley with the Zainab herd-wardens at Zainab Camp regarding the poisoned guar-wallows
quest.nirncraft.story_grazelands_02_feve: Clear the blighted kwama warriors inside Mudan-Mul Egg Mine and seal the leaking Dwemer pipe
Seek the Wise Woman's counsel at Ahemmusa Camp on the source of the subterranean conduit
Obtain a brass valve-key from the apothecaries of Tel Mora
quest.nirncraft.story_grazelands_03_pump: Enter the flooded Dwemer halls of Nchardahrk and shut down the corrupted blight-cistern
Clear the cultist saboteurs camped in the outer gallery of Mzuleft
Recover the stolen Zainab grazing-totem from the shore ruins of Ald Daedroth
quest.nirncraft.story_grazelands_04_comp: Return the grazing-totem to Ashkhan Kaushad's hearth at Zainab Camp
Witness Master Aryon's Mouth and the Ashlander envoys seal the Savannah Grazing Compact at Tel Vos
Celebrate the reopening of the clean cistern-wells with the farmers of Vos
quest.nirncraft.story.azuras_coast.title: The Twilight Lantern of Holamayan
quest.nirncraft.story.azuras_coast.rumou: At the Buoyant Armiger canton of Molag Mar, pilgrims bound for Mount Assarnibibi report that renegade inquisitors and Tel Aruhn slavers have blockaded the sea-coving toward Holamayan while corprus remedies vanish on the road to Tel Fyr.
quest.nirncraft.story.azuras_coast.notic: MOLAG MAR PILGRIM GARRISON — Escorts and investigators sought to secure the coastal shrines between Molag Mar, Tel Fyr, and the eastern headlands.
quest.nirncraft.story_azuras_coast_01_pi: Alms and Armigers at Molag Mar
Speak with the Buoyant Armiger captain at Molag Mar about the missing medical skiffs
Check the pilgrim way-cairn atop Mount Assarnibibi for signs of the ambushed courier
Deliver the recovered medicine tally to Divayth Fyr's tower at Tel Fyr
quest.nirncraft.story_azuras_coast_02_ri: Question the dock-masters at Tel Aruhn regarding the seized Holamayan skiff
Inspect the lava-plain relay post at Tel Uvirith
Clear the smuggler-mercenaries inside the stronghold of Telasero and recover the Twilight Compass
quest.nirncraft.story_azuras_coast_03_cl: Deliver the Twilight Compass to Master Gilvas Barelo at Holamayan Monastery
Drive off the rogue inquisitor band encamped in the ruins of Indoranyon
Retrieve the stolen Star-Lamp of Azura from the observatory vaults of Galom Daeus
quest.nirncraft.story_azuras_coast_04_da: Relight the Star-Lamp above the sea-gate of Holamayan Monastery
Confirm the safe arrival of the alchemical supply skiff at Tel Fyr
Report the coastal truce to the Buoyant Armiger Commander at Molag Mar
quest.nirncraft.story.west_gash.title: Two Seals on the Caldera Seam
quest.nirncraft.story.west_gash.rumour: Along the Odai River in Balmora, Hlaalu council clerks and Moonmoth Legion officers trade accusations over missing raw ebony shipments from Caldera while Camonna Tong toughs watch from the cornerclubs.
quest.nirncraft.story.west_gash.notice: HLAALU COUNCIL MANOR, BALMORA — Investigators commissioned to audit the missing ebony tallies between Balmora, Caldera, and Moonmoth Legion Fort.
quest.nirncraft.story_west_gash_01_ledge: Inspect the disputed assay books at Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora
Verify the Imperial escort logs with the knight-captain at Moonmoth Legion Fort
Question the magistrate's clerks inside the Tudor guild-hall at Caldera
quest.nirncraft.story_west_gash_02_contr: Inspect the hidden ore-chute at Caldera Mine and question the night-shift foreman
Check the Odai river-barge moorings below Rethan Manor
Intercept the smuggler skiff crew at the stilts of Hla Oad
quest.nirncraft.story_west_gash_03_vault: Storm the coastal stronghold of Hlormaren and defeat the syndicate factor's guards
Recover the stamped Imperial ebony ingots hidden inside the Dwemer gallery at Bthanchend
Deliver the recovered ingots to the Hlaalu escrow post at Odai Plateau
quest.nirncraft.story_west_gash_04_settl: File the restored assay rolls at the Magistrate's Hall in Caldera
Present the signed Caldera-Balmora Assay Compact at Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora
Receive your factor's share and title on the bridges of Balmora
quest.nirncraft.story.bitter_coast.title: Lanterns in the Mangrove Mire
quest.nirncraft.story.bitter_coast.rumou: On the wooden boardwalks of Gnaar Mok, net-fishers whisper that an Imperial revenue cutter vanished in the fog off Khartag Point while bribed excise clerks look the other way.
quest.nirncraft.story.bitter_coast.notic: COASTAL EXCISE NOTICE AT GNAAR MOK — Reward offered for locating the missing revenue cutter crew and auditing the smuggler coves between Gnaar Mok and Zainsipilu.
quest.nirncraft.story_bitter_coast_01_wr: Question the net-fishers on the stilt-piers of Gnaar Mok about the missing revenue cutter
Search the rocky headland at Khartag Point for the cutter's shattered lantern-box
Inspect the coastal watch-platform at Dubdil Alar Tower for signal-ash
quest.nirncraft.story_bitter_coast_02_co: Clear the smuggler lookouts inside the sea-caverns of Nammu and free the captive oarsmen
Seize the bribed customs-cipher book from the tide-cache at Mannammu
Track the syndicate's quartermaster to the mangrove grotto of Zainsipilu
quest.nirncraft.story_bitter_coast_03_al: Storm the Daedric mire-ruin of Ashalmimilkala and defeat the corrupt excise-master's guard
Recover the Imperial Excise Brass Seal from the flooded vaults of Ashurnibibi
Burn the contraband moon-sugar depot hidden inside Ulummusa
quest.nirncraft.story_bitter_coast_04_sa: Relight the true coast-lantern atop Khartag Point
Return the Imperial Excise Brass Seal to the freed cutter captain at Gnaar Mok
Accept the gratitude of Gnaar Mok's fishers on the boardwalk pier
quest.nirncraft.story.ascadian_isles.rum: In the Foreign Quarter and St. Olms canals of Vivec City, chalk drawings of twin lanterns appear beside locked sewer grates while bounty-hunters from Dren Plantation prowl the bridges toward Suran.
quest.nirncraft.story.ascadian_isles.not: OFFICE OF ARCHCANON SARYONI, HIGH FANE OF VIVEC — Discreet mediator sought to investigate the underworks disturbances between Vivec City, Pelagiad, and Suran.
quest.nirncraft.story_ascadian_isles_01_: Chalk Marks on St. Olms Canal
Inspect the twin-lantern chalk marks in the underworks of Vivec City
Meet the pilgrim courier waiting beside the muck-shrine at Fields of Kummu
Speak with the sympathetic Legion quartermaster inside Fort Pelagiad at Pelagiad
quest.nirncraft.story_ascadian_isles_02_: Slip into the guard-house at Dren Plantation and seize the slave-hunters' ambush roster
Free the detained Khajiit and Argonian labourers held at Arvel Plantation
Warn the Twin Lamps ferryman waiting by the river-landing at Suran
quest.nirncraft.story_ascadian_isles_03_: Defeat the hired syndicate manhunters blocking the hill-pass at Marandus
Secure the outbound ship-papers at the Census and Excise office in Seyda Neen
Register the Imperial manumission seals at Castle Ebonheart
quest.nirncraft.story_ascadian_isles_04_: See the freed passengers safely aboard the coastal packet at Seyda Neen
Deliver the manumission register to Archcanon Saryoni at the High Fane in Vivec City
Receive the Pilgrim's Lantern of Grace on the Temple steps of Vivec City
quest.nirncraft.story.red_mountain.title: The Cracking Pylon of Ghostgate
quest.nirncraft.story.red_mountain.rumou: Between the Tower of Dawn and Tower of Dusk at Ghostgate, Buoyant Armigers and Ordinators report that three bone-pylons along the Ghostfence have begun to hum in dissonance with Dagoth Ur's ash-storms.
quest.nirncraft.story.red_mountain.notic: GHOSTGATE CITADEL COMMAND — Veteran volunteers required to inspect the bone-pylons along Foyada Ashur-Dan and purge the Sixth House resonators inside the Ghostfence.
quest.nirncraft.story_red_mountain_01_di: Bone and Blue Fire at Ghostgate
Report to the Armiger captain in the Tower of Dusk at Ghostgate
Inspect the cracked ancestral bone-pylon along the Ghostfence perimeter
Clear the ash-ghoul scouting party advancing down Foyada Ashur-Dan
quest.nirncraft.story_red_mountain_02_co: Follow the ash-storm ridge through the Valley of the Wind
Retrieve the Dwemer grounding-rod from the steam-galleries of Mzanchend
Defeat the Ascended Sleeper relay-keeper atop the stronghold of Falensarano
quest.nirncraft.story_red_mountain_03_ch: Ascend the basalt gorge of Foyada Esannudan inside the Ghostfence
Shatter the secondary ash-harmonic bells mounted in the ruins of Nchuleft
Slay the Dagoth heart-priest conducting the blight-storm on the rim of Red Mountain
quest.nirncraft.story_red_mountain_04_vi: Drive the Dwemer grounding-rod into the repaired bone-pylon at the Ghostfence
Return the consecrated ancestor-casket to the reliquary of Ghostgate
Receive the Salute of the Two Towers from the Armigers and Ordinators at Ghostgate
quest.nirncraft.story.solstheim.title: Ash and All-Maker's Stone
quest.nirncraft.story.solstheim.rumour: Behind the bulwark of Raven Rock, Redoran guards battle ash-spawn from the southern waste while Skaal hunters report sleep-walking villagers chanting around the Earth Stone.
quest.nirncraft.story.solstheim.notice: COUNCILOR MORVAYN'S MANOR, RAVEN ROCK — Aid requested to defend the ash-bulwark, consult Master Neloth at Tel Mithryn, and parley with the Skaal.
quest.nirncraft.story_solstheim_01_bulwa: Speak with Councilor Morvayn's guard-captain at the southern bulwark of Raven Rock
Clear the ash-spawn patrol advancing past Old Attius Farm
Inspect the entranced stone-workers gathered around the Earth Stone
quest.nirncraft.story_solstheim_02_heart: Consult Master Neloth inside the giant mushroom tower of Tel Mithryn
Disrupt the Morag Tong renegade cell fortifying Ashfallow Citadel
Shatter the heartstone-resonator hidden in the curtain wall of Fort Frostmoth
quest.nirncraft.story_solstheim_03_steam: Take counsel with the Skaal elders at Skaal Village on the corrupted All-Maker conduits
Rally the Nord warriors at Thirsk Mead Hall to guard the northern pass
Enter the sunken Dwemer city of Nchardak and release the steam-aqueduct locks
quest.nirncraft.story_solstheim_04_accor: Defeat the cult overseers in the outer sanctum of the Temple of Miraak
Bring word of the cleansed sanctum to the Greathall of Skaal Village
Witness Councilor Morvayn and the Skaal envoys seal the Solstheim Island Accord in Raven Rock
